svg.aria-label: Experience: Prompt Engineering Intern at SkillCraft Technology (Jan 2026 to Feb 2026): wrote deterministic prompts with constraints and roles, designed prompts that turn unstructured text into reliable JSON, built an interview bot, a tutoring agent and a task assistant, and measured output consistency. PR Lead at AMCFOSS: club communications, sponsorship outreach and partnership materials. B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering, third year, at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Chennai.
